findings.fix_hint: Create an AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md) at the repo root describing the project, build commands, and coding conventions. Run `tt inspect --suggest-agents-md` for a generated starter.
findings.message: This project uses LLM libraries but has no AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .cursorrules file. Without a project-context file, AI tools work blind and users must provide verbose prompts on every session.
